theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

top_news.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for July 29
top_news.summary: Oil rebounded after a three-day decline as tensions persisted across the Middle East, with continued threats to energy flows despite a push by the US to try to forge a diplomatic solution to end the war with Iran.

top_news.title: Asian Stocks Eye Gains as Oil Offsets Chip Selloff: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Asian stocks were mostly poised for gains after a three-day slide in oil prices boosted risk sentiment, while concerns over artificial intelligence spending continued to weigh on semiconductor shares.

top_news.title: S&P Global’s Shares Drop as Company Misses Profit Estimates
top_news.summary: S&P Global Inc. posted quarterly results that fell short of analysts’ average estimate, hurt by factors including the US-Iran War making it harder to boost pricing on contracts for its energy data, news and analysis unit.

top_news.title: Bloom Surges After Raising Guidance as Earnings Double Estimates
top_news.summary: Bloom Energy Corp. jumped after the fuel-cell maker posted earnings that were more than double expectations and raised full-year guidance for the second consecutive quarter, a sign of rampant demand from data centers.

top_news.title: First Brands Bankruptcy: Lawsuits Around Alleged Fraud Seek to Recoup Billions
top_news.summary: The pitch to creditors of bankrupt First Brands goes like this: Stick with us just a while longer, and you’ll get a full recovery as we claw back $2 billion from suing a long list of insiders and business partners who allegedly perpetrated a widespread fraud.

top_news.title: BlackRock Private Credit Plans Ramp Up in Challenge to Blackstone, Apollo
top_news.summary: With direct lending powerhouse HPS in the fold, the world’s largest asset manager is pushing past its own challenges to angle for a large slice of the industry’s future.

top_news.title: Emerging Currencies Traded Mixed Amid Oil Plunge, Fed Bets
top_news.summary: Emerging-market currencies traded mixed on Tuesday as oil plunged on optimism over US-Iran talks and traders adjusted positions ahead of the Federal Reserve rate decision.

top_news.title: Insurers Rally as Stocks Shift from AI Loser to Safe Haven
top_news.summary: US insurance-related stocks rallied Tuesday, pushing an industry gauge to close at a record, as artificial intelligence concerns drove traders toward defensive parts of the market.

top_news.title: UPS CEO Says the Amazon Glide Down Is 'Behind Us'
top_news.summary: United Parcel Service CEO Carol Tomé says the Amazon glide down "is behind us." The shipping company has been delivering fewer low-margin packages for Amazon. UPS shares fell after its outlook for volume and profit margins underwhelmed investors. Tomé speaks on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: ‘Debt Can Be a Real Issue’ for CoreWeave, Says Damodaran
top_news.summary: NYU Stern Kerschner Family Chair in Finance Education Aswath Damodaran discusses the AI investment cycle and says smaller companies like CoreWeave are in ‘danger territory’ when it comes to debt, but does not see a concern for larger companies. He speaks with Emily Graffeo and Romaine Bostick on ‘The Close.’ (Source: Bloomberg)
